name: Congreso de los Diputados
notes: 350 seats. The Cortes were dissolved on 2026-10-06 and a deputy's mandate ends on the day of dissolution, so only the deputies who stay on hold a seat until the new Cortes meet.

name: Senado
notes: 266 seats (208 elected by province and 58 designated by the autonomous communities), XV legislature elected 23 July 2023. The Cortes were dissolved on 6 October 2026 for the election of 29 November 2026, so the members shown are the senators of the legislature at its end, from the Spanish Wikipedia list (senado.es refuses scripts), a secondary source; replace it with the new Senate's list once it meets. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
